The deciding difference is item 2: B adds a skip link past the 12 nav links, and A has none. B loses some credit on item 5 because it restyles the nav with flex and a gap, which changes how the page looks after being asked not to redesign. That is a smaller fault than A leaving out the skip link entirely. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers fix the title, the heading levels, the button names and order, and the focus outline in nearly the same way.
